overview: Val-d'Or counted 32,752 residents in the 2021 Census, up 0.8 percent from 32,491 in 2016. The median age is 43.2, the median household income was $75,500 in 2020, and 15,033 dwellings are occupied by usual residents.

Gold mining sets the pace, with Eldorado and Agnico Eagle investing nearby and a large industrial park tied to the mines. Growth is flat, so a local business wins mainly by taking share from competitors and by serving well-paid mining households and the contractors that supply them.
